mouth.name: Mouth & Oral Cavity
mouth.description: Site of ingestion, mechanical chewing (mastication), and chemical digestion of starch by salivary amylase.

esophagus.name: Esophagus (Gullet)
esophagus.description: Muscular tube that transports bolus from pharynx to stomach via rhythmic waves of peristalsis.

liver.name: Liver
liver.description: Large metabolic organ producing bile salts that emulsify lipids; deaminates excess amino acids and stores glycogen.

stomach.name: Stomach
stomach.description: Muscular J-shaped sac churning food into chyme; secretes gastric juice (hydrochloric acid and pepsin) for protein digestion.

pancreas.name: Pancreas
pancreas.description: Accessory glandular organ secreting pancreatic juice (trypsin, amylase, lipase, and sodium bicarbonate) into duodenum.

small_intestine.name: Small Intestine (Ileum)
small_intestine.description: Primary site of terminal chemical digestion and nutrient absorption; internal wall lined with microscopic villi.

large_intestine.name: Large Intestine (Colon)
large_intestine.description: Reabsorbs water, mineral salts, and vitamins from indigestible residue, compacting waste into feces.

rectum.name: Rectum & Anus
rectum.description: Terminal chamber storing feces prior to controlled defecation (egestion) through the anal sphincter.
